patch_description: Combines the higher-accuracy RY–RZ–CZ–RZ structure with the current program’s parameter efficiency and brick-wall scheduling. The pre- and post-entanglement RZ gates share parameters because all intervening CZ gates commute with RZ; this preserves the effective phase freedom while reducing the circuit from 24 to 16 parameters per block (98 total parameters). Reordering the seven line-connectivity CZ gates into two disjoint brick-wall layers implements the same entangling unitary with lower scheduled depth.
